title: Refinement doesn't clear if same attribute is present with 2 different filters
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

We have a specific need where we need to have a range filter as long as some preset filters that filter by single value.

So for example: a year range filter where you can filter >= xYear, but at the same time be able to just filter by year = xYear.

To da that we are combining a range with a refinement list, but when clearing, the refinementList does not clear when using clearRefinements

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Add a filter with the range. eg: min: 2500.
2. Filter with a preset
3. Clear refinement

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/github/algolia/instantsearch/tree/templates/react-instantsearch

### 💭 Expected behavior

Expected Behaviour: all filters clear
Actual behaviour: only range clears

### Package version

"instantsearch.js": "^4.78.3"
"react-instantsearch": "^7.15.7"
"react-instantsearch-nextjs": "^0.4.9"
